summary: Iteration 4 tested the NEW optional custom-photo upload feature end-to-end. Backend: 31/31 pytest passing including 3 new tests (custom-photo path, AI-image path, auth protection with image). Frontend: full Playwright flow validated — admin login via /control-login, open manual-upload-modal, upload a photo (preview + remove button visible), submit, modal closes with success toast, new pending card appears whose image_url is the watermarked uploaded photo (data:image/jpeg;base64, 5103 bytes — much smaller than typical AI image). Submission WITHOUT photo also works and produces AI image draft. Regression: public home shows 'Ghaziabad Times' with no admin anchors, /admin redirects to /control-login when logged out, gt_token stored on login. Iteration-3 bugs (settings watermark rebrand + email-only lockout 429) verified FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: process_item: AI image generation is skipped when custom image provided — correct. But if add_watermark raises on malformed base64, art.image_url stays empty and the AI fallback is NOT triggered (the `if not art.image_url` check only runs inside the try block after rewrite). Behavior is acceptable (admin controls the input) but worth logging; currently only logger.error is emitted.
ManualUpload.image_base64 has no server-side size cap; a hostile admin could POST a very large data URL. Frontend caps at 8MB, but backend should enforce a limit too (defense in depth).
server.py is still ~660 lines — consider splitting into routers as flagged previously.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. 5 TEST-prefixed draft articles created during testing were deleted via DELETE /api/articles/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests now cover custom-photo path (test_manual_upload_with_custom_photo) and AI image baseline (test_manual_upload_without_photo_uses_ai) plus a 401 check with image payload. Size comparison asserts custom data URL < 200KB and smaller than AI output. All iteration 1-3 regressions remain green.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified; no bugs reproduced.
